raw_design.passed_qc_note: the release contains QC-passed wells only, so QC removals are not visible

time_of_read.note: units and meaning are not documented in the release; not used

assay_sources.tyner_2018: Tyner et al., Nature 562:526-531 (2018), PMC6280667, Methods: 7-point 3-fold series (10 to 0.0137 uM; 1 to 0.00137 uM for 4 drugs), one well per concentration, 10,000 cells per well in 384-well plates, plated within 24 h of collection, 72 h culture, MTS read; DMSO vehicle and a positive-control combination on each plate; probit fit on 7 points
assay_sources.bottomly_2022: Bottomly et al., Cancer Cell 40:850-864 (2022), PMC9378589: same assay as 2018; profiles removed when deviance > 2 and AIC > 12; plates removed when >= 4 concentrations have SD > 25

action_mapping.returns: one archived probit AUC summary for a (sample, inhibitor) pair, or nothing if the archive has no QC-passed profile
action_mapping.physical_cost: none at replay time; it stands for one past 7-dose profile
1 treatment well per replicate plus shared plate controls; not what the replay's AUC endpoint can grade

action_mapping.returns: a 7-point dose-response curve, probit fit and QC
action_mapping.physical_cost: 7 treatment wells per replicate, 10,000 cells per well, plus plate controls; profiles can fail curve or plate QC

action_mapping.returns: a new batch of profiles chosen from first-round readouts
action_mapping.physical_cost: a new plate set with its own controls, about 72 h more culture, and banked cells; the replay assumes the response state is unchanged between rounds, which it cannot test

notes: Paired comparisons at equal query counts are unaffected; only low-cost claims change.
Cells per sample at one replicate: 16 profiles x 7 wells x 10,000 = 1.12 million, before controls.
API spend (0.28 USD for 520 LLM calls) is a small part of the cost of a bridged campaign.
Basal RNA is pre-treatment, but the replay assumes its analysis is available before the first selection; turnaround for RNA-seq is not modelled.
